newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL SENATE OKS BILL TO STREAMLINE LEGAL SYSTEM.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL SENATE OKS BILL TO STREAMLINE LEGAL SYSTEM.

text.p: Brazil's Senate approved for a second and final time Tuesday a bill which seeks to streamline the country's overloaded legal system, an official said.
The bill, a constitutional amendment, now goes to the Chamber of Deputies where it needs a further three-fifths majorities for full approval in Congress.

The bill would prevent lower courts from ruling on constitutional issues that have already been settled by more than a two-thirds majority of the 11 judges who sit on the Supreme Federal Tribunal, Brazils's highest court.
Critics of the bill say it would reduce the independence of Brazil's legal system. Supporters argue it is needed to reduce the workload of the overburdened courts.
